commits_trailer_note: Every commit message carries REQ, Commit-Kind, Orch-Run, Orch-Wave 17, Orch-Stage 11 and Orch-Lane lines, but a blank line separates them from the final Co-Authored-By line, so git parses only Co-Authored-By as the trailer block (`git log --format=%(trailers:key=Orch-Wave)` is empty). History was not rewritten, per the brief. The lines are recoverable with `git log --format=%B | grep -E '^(REQ|Commit-Kind|Orch-[A-Za-z]+):'`.

review_outcome.notes: The Agent tool started every subagent asynchronously in this environment (run_in_background was never set); the worker waited for each one in the same turn by polling a result file in short foreground commands. The first kiwi-coder (SEC-PROXY-004) got the result-file instruction by SendMessage. Classification used the fixed keep/drop mapping applied by the lead. FND-201 (a behaviour change introduced by the clean-code fix) was handled under the clean-code rule and not counted as a block finding, so fix-induced-defects-majority did not fire; the host may reclassify it.

srs_deltas.detail: The proxy keeps byte 0xE9 as U+00E9 and the committed in-memory adapter test (BackendResponseParserTest#sec_PROXY_004_AC9_latin1HeaderBytesReachTheClientAsTheSameSingleBytes) is green. Over a real TinyHttpd 3.1.1 socket the client gets 0xC3 0xA9 because TinyHttpd writes header chars as UTF-8. ../TinyHttpd and NaruServe-tinyhttpd were not changed and no workaround was added; please amend AC-9 to name the adapters it holds for (or wait for a TinyHttpd fix). The red socket test was not committed.

srs_deltas.detail: The 64 KiB bound counts the status line and header lines with their line terminators but not the blank line ending the head; interim 1xx heads share the same bound with the final head. The bound is charged before the status line is parsed, so an over-bound malformed status line fails on the bound.

Review FND-001: a body-capable HTTP/1.0 backend response carrying Transfer-Encoding is now INVALID_RESPONSE (RFC 9112 6.1 faulty framing, 6.3 -> 502); HEAD/204/304 stay bodyless first. Suggest an AC so the rule is traced.

srs_deltas.detail: The total-timeout watchdog is not installed yet (ProxyExchange.NO_WATCHDOG), so mapping a watchdog close during the body to TOTAL_TIMEOUT is left to wave 18 (FR-PROXY-015/017). Short body, malformed chunk and read timeout are mapped, logged once and rethrown.
